author: bardic-inspiration
name: Goblin Warren-King
summary: A cunning goblin chieftain who rules by cruelty and sends the rabble in first.
description: The warren-king has survived every coup, which is the only qualification that counts. They keep a few loyal bodyguards, many disloyal ones, and a very good sense of when to look the other way.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The king makes two Scimitar attacks.

bonusActions.name: Rabble Rush
bonusActions.text: Up to three Goblinoid allies the king can see within 30 feet can each use its {ref:glossary/reaction} to move up to half its Speed without provoking {ref:glossary/opportunity-attacks}.

reactions.name: Shove an Underling
reactions.text: *Trigger:* A creature the king can see makes an attack roll against it. *Response:* The king chooses a Small or Medium ally within 5 feet of it. The king and that ally swap places, and the ally becomes the target of the attack instead.
